legend.en: The auspicators of the Ravenwing are sleepless, and from ideal hunting vantages, there is nowhere the foe can hide for long.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RAVENWING FLY unit has shot.

effect.en: Visible enemy units within 6" of your unit have +3" detection range.

legend.en: The Ravenwing's aerial assets are capable of swift and reactive manoeuvring to new firing positions, ensuring opportunities for rapid vengeance.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged RAVENWING FLY unit has shot.

effect.en: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

legend.en: Through subtle manoeuvring and empowered cameleoline armour, the swiftest of the Ravenwing evade attempts to bring their hunt to an end.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly RAVENWING FLY/MOUNTED unit.

legend.en: So driven by duty are the veterans of the Unforgiven that even death cannot keep them from it.

when.en: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly DEATHWING unit.

effect.en: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is engaged with an enemy unit within range of your vowed objective: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

legend.en: The Deathwing employ ancient and incredibly powerful teleportariums, some older than the Great Crusade, to strike at their foes with unparalleled safety and accuracy.

when.en: Your Movement phase, when a friendly DEATHWING unit with the Deep Strike ability is selected to make an ingress move.

effect.en: Your unit can be set up more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units (instead of more than 8"). Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of this turn.

legend.en: Channelling the strategic puissance and measured ferocity of their gene-sire, the veterans of the Unforgiven unleash a perfectly timed and utterly lethal storm of tightly controlled violence.

when.en: Your Charge phase, when a friendly DEATHWING unit ends a charge move.

effect.en: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit: For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

legend.en: Those inducted into the Dark Angels’ Inner Circle will gladly give their lives in pursuit of victory, and to see the Fallen brought to justice.

when.en: Any phase, when a friendly DEATHWING/RAVENWING unit within range of an objective is destroyed.

target.en: That DEATHWING/RAVENWING unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is destroyed.

effect.en: Select one objective: That no enemy units (excluding AIRCRAFT units) are within range of. That your unit was controlling at the end of the previous phase. That objective is secured.

legend.en: Unflinching in their loyalty to Chapter and Primarch, Dark Angels battle-brothers seize and hold their objectives with unrelenting determination and zealous fury.

target.en: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is within range of an objective.

effect.en: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

legend.en: The Dark Angels are relentless in the pursuit of their foes, striking with ruthless ferocity and precision to take the heads of those who have crossed the Chapter.

when.en: The Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is selected to fight.

legend.en: When the constituent elements of the Dark Angels fight as one, the enemy is often overwhelmed and torn apart by the Chapter’s tactical flexibility and mastery of rapid warfare.

effect.en: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

legend.en: Atop their snarling mechanical steeds, the warriors of the Ravenwing surge through seemingly impassable terrain, smashing through rubble and ruin to unleash the wrath of the Unforgiven upon unsuspecting targets.

when.en: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly RAVENWING unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

legend.en: Amongst the many secrets hoarded by the Dark Angels are those technological in nature. The armouries of the Rock contain potent weapons unseen in the armouries of other Chapters.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks have +2 S.
